title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
raw_text:
Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models.

The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder.
reason_zh: 图灵奖得主Sutton批评合成数据，提出大世界假说，对AI发展路径有深刻启示。
summary_zh: 图灵奖得主Richard Sutton在The Decoder的报道中称，合成数据是扩展大语言模型的“大错误”。他认为世界是无限复杂的，任何模拟都无法完全捕捉其多样性。他提出“大世界假说”，强调真实数据的重要性，对当前AI训练方法提出质疑。
title_zh: AI先驱Sutton称合成数据是“大错误”

title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20318v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing suites are won by collecting data or by tuning hyperparameters, and none tells a change to how a run is executed apart from a change to how the model learns. We present AI4AI\mbox{-}Bench, 10 frozen research repositories spanning 10 training algorithm families. In each task, an agent has 4 hours on one B300 to rewrite the training algorithm; its code is then rerun from scratch for up to 12 hours and scored by a fixed evaluator hidden from the agent,
reason_zh: 提出递归自我改进的基准测试，评估LLM代理在算法设计上的能力，对AI自我进化研究有开创性意义。
summary_zh: 本文提出AI4AI-Bench，一个用于评估LLM代理在算法设计上递归自我改进能力的基准。递归自我改进（RSI）要求AI系统改进产生AI系统的过程，即训练算法。基准测试代理能否设计更好的目标函数或更新规则，以提升后续训练的效率。实验显示当前模型在简单任务上有所改进，但复杂任务仍具挑战，为RSI研究提供了标准化评估工具。
title_zh: AI4AI-Bench：递归自我改进中算法设计的LLM代理基准

title: Manifold Drift in Flow Preference Optimization: A Root Cause of Reward Hacking
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20011v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Preference optimization is a standard alignment method for generative models, yet extending it to continuous-time dynamics remains non-trivial. In flow matching, reward-driven updates modify transport trajectories without an inherent constraint to the pretrained data manifold and can move terminal samples off the pretrained support. We formalize this failure mode as manifold drift. Theoretically, we show that optimal flow matching recovers the terminal data distribution, whereas a preference update leaves the pretrained manifold whenever its induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component. As a remedy, we propose ThermoDPO, a temperature-controlled objective that anchors pairwise preference optimization on preferred samples. Across temperature regimes, this objective connects rejection sampling fine-tuning and FlowDPO and controls a pointwise reconstruction-based surrogate for manifold distance. reason_zh: 揭示流匹配偏好优化中的流形漂移是奖励黑客的根源，对对齐研究有重要启示。
summary_zh: 偏好优化是生成模型的标准对齐方法，但将其扩展到连续时间动力学仍然困难。在流匹配中，奖励驱动的更新修改传输轨迹，而没有对预训练数据流形的固有约束，可能将终端样本移出预训练支持。本文形式化了这一现象，并证明流形漂移是奖励黑客的根源。通过分析，提出了可能的缓解策略，为流匹配对齐提供了理论指导。

title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.19303v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When a tool call times out, the agent sees the failure and can route around it. A cached error page or negative price can instead arrive in the expected format and be consumed as fact. In tau-bench retail, completion improves by 14.0 and 12.0 points on two tiers. In separate ToolMaze controls, removing the recovery-tool list eliminates the measured gain and restoring it recovers the effect; diagnostic detail and timing produce no detectable differences. reason_zh: 针对工具静默失败问题提出Outcome Monitors，检测结果契约违规，提升Agent可靠性，实用性强。
summary_zh: 本文针对AI代理中工具调用静默失败的问题，提出Outcome Monitors机制。当工具调用超时时，代理能看到失败并绕行，但缓存错误页面或负价格可能以预期格式到达并被当作事实消费。Outcome Monitors通过从任务无关轨迹或公共模式中挖掘结果契约，检测违规行为。一旦违规，监控器会触发恢复机制，防止代理基于错误信息行动。该研究对提升代理系统的鲁棒性有重要价值。

title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.19729v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting arbitrary safe and unsafe trajectories mixes the safety signal with unrelated differences. We propose SafeBranch, a framework that aligns an embodied actor on safety through branch pairs constructed from the actor's own unsafe rollouts via environment rollback. reason_zh: 针对具身智能体的交互安全问题，提出分支对安全对齐方法，在保证任务完成的同时提升安全性，实用性强。
summary_zh: 基于视觉语言模型的具身智能体能够完成指令任务，但过程中常违反安全约束，这被称为交互安全问题。训练这类智能体安全行动具有挑战性，因为安全与任务成功是不同目标，且安全仅出现在少数关键步骤。本文提出SafeBranch方法，通过分支对安全对齐，在安全关键步骤进行专门训练，实验表明在多个具身任务中显著提升安全性而不牺牲任务成功率。
title_zh: SafeBranch：具身智能体的分支对安全对齐

title: ADAPT: Physics-Aware Diffusion-based World Models for Adaptive Predictive Transferable HVAC Control

reason_zh: 提出物理感知的扩散世界模型用于HVAC自适应预测控制，应对建筑能耗挑战，具有重要应用价值。
summary_zh: 建筑约占全球能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的三分之一，优化室内气候系统对城市气候缓解至关重要。然而，室内延迟热力学响应和部分可观测性严重阻碍现有方法。本文提出ADAPT，一种物理感知的扩散世界模型，用于自适应预测性可迁移HVAC控制。通过结合物理知识，模型能够更准确地预测室内热动态，并实现跨建筑迁移，实验表明在能耗和舒适度方面优于现有方法。

title: ReguSim: Evaluating LLM Agent Rule Grounding in Financial Compliance
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.19974v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents in financial markets may cite rules yet still submit orders that violate executable constraints or misread surveillance evidence. We introduce ReguSim, a controlled financial-compliance environment, and ReguBench, a target-marked monitoring benchmark, to separate four artifacts: stated reasoning, attempted action, execution enforcement, and monitor evidence. In trader runs with DeepSeek V4 Pro and Gemini 3.5 Flash, visible rules reduce but do not eliminate rejected actions, and incentive or persona framing shifts behavior. A bridge study shows that trader rationales can mislead an independent monitor unless enforcement evidence is shown. In monitoring, simple structured baselines either match or exceed prompt-only LLMs. The results frame financial compliance evaluation as an audit of rule-grounded actions and evidence use, rather than a single compliance score.
reason_zh: 提出金融合规场景的LLM智能体规则遵循评估基准，对AI安全与合规有重要价值。
summary_zh: 本文介绍ReguSim，一个受控的金融合规环境，以及ReguBench，一个目标标记的监控基准，用于评估LLM智能体在金融合规中的规则遵循能力。现有LLM智能体可能引用规则但仍提交违反可执行约束的订单或误读监控证据。ReguBench分离了四个伪影：陈述推理、尝试行动、执行强制和监控。该基准有助于识别和改善LLM智能体在合规任务中的可靠性。
title_zh: ReguSim：评估金融合规中LLM智能体的规则遵循能力

title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.19202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In deterministic settings, the epistemic term reduces to expected information gain, optionally normalized by token cost. We instantiate the framework in Optimal Question Asking (OQA), with exact posteriors and a dynamic programming oracle, and benchmark frontier language models on binary and multiway categorical tasks from 25 to 300 candidates. We also study clarification before generation and automa
reason_zh: 提出主动推理用于上下文获取，为AI代理提供新框架，有理论深度。
summary_zh: 该论文提出将主动推理应用于AI代理的上下文获取。交互式AI代理必须高效获取正确的上下文。当用户省略约束、偏好、文件或任务变量时，代理可以采取默认假设或花费token进行澄清问题、检索调用、工具调用或提示试验。论文将此权衡形式化为上下文获取的主动推理，可能提供一种优化代理决策的方法。

title: The Third Restructuring of Software Form: From the Three-Tier Architecture to Storage, Models, and Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20201v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Software form has undergone two paradigm shifts since its inception: Software 1.0, in which instructions determine behavior, and Software 2.0, in which data determines behavior (machine learning). This paper argues that a third shift - Software 3.0, in which context and reasoning determine behavior - is now underway, and contends that its terminal form converges to three elements: a generalized database (the unified abstraction of all persistent state and memory), a large model (the intelligence core that performs reasoning and generation), and an agent (the execution loop connecting the first two). The core argument is as follows: in the traditional three-tier architecture, the user-interface layer will be absorbed by the model's ability to generate interfaces on demand, the business-logic layer will be re-partitioned along "expressibility x criticality" into model reasoning and storage constraints (with residual deterministic logic ret
reason_zh: 提出软件形式第三次重构的论点，从三层架构到存储、模型与代理，具有深刻洞察和启发性。
summary_zh: 软件形式自诞生以来经历了两次范式转变：软件1.0中指令决定行为，软件2.0中数据决定行为（机器学习）。本文认为第三次转变——软件3.0，其中上下文和推理决定行为——正在进行中，并主张其最终形式将涉及存储、模型和代理的重新组织。这一观点对软件架构的未来发展具有深远影响。
title_zh: 软件形式的第三次重构：从三层架构到存储、模型与代理

title: Scaling agentic AI: Enterprise patterns without vendor lock-in
raw_text: Scaling agentic AI across an enterprise requires patterns that preserve flexibility while avoiding vendor lock-in. In this second post of our multi-agent series, we examine how ML teams operate many agentic AI systems across a multi-everything environment of frameworks, models, and providers, and the principles that let those systems scale together.

- Added `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` commands for managing the working directory in TUI sessions. (#38894)
- Added `codex queue` for sending messages to existing local or remote sessions. (#39092)
- Expanded Vim editing with character replacement and more change motions such as `cw`, `c$`, and `cc`. (#39661)
- `codex doctor` now diagnoses endpoint protection, network/proxy failures, desktop app state, and update connectivity. (#38827, #38918, #39060, #39074)
- SDK users can now pass exact CLI config overrides and select `max` or `ultra` reasoning effort. (#38817, #39662)

## Bug Fixes

- Queued messages now wake idle sessions reliably, resolve duplicate session names more usefully, and preserve pasted or deferred command semantics. (#39034, #39385, #39604)
- Resumed and forked threads now restore thei

> [!TIP]
> This release features several new pipelines, including LTX2.5, MiniMax H3, and Wan Animate 2. We're also graduating Modular Diffusers out of the experimental phase and announcing its stable support. Additionally, this release includes minimal support for tensor-parallel. There's a lot more that went down in this release. So, please consult the notes for details. 

## New Pipelines

### MiniMax-H3

[**MiniMax-H3**](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/main/api/pipelines/minimax_h3) generates video and its soundtrack together. A single transformer denoises one packed sequence containing the text conditioning, the conditioning media, and the target video *and* audio latents — there is no separate vocoder and no post-hoc audio pass. Its conditioner is a `Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration` whose unnormalized 50th-decoder-layer hidden state is read instead of the last one.
